en: The black and white image depicts an inner courtyard of a Renaissance-style building, featuring ornate arched galleries, intricate window frames, and a tiled roof. In the center of the courtyard, there is a distinctive wrought-iron well structure with a cover. One person is visible standing near the side of the building, providing a sense of scale. The architecture is monumental and elaborate, typical of grand city palaces or castles in Central Europe.
